User: I think my fast food pattern has been pretty consistent this past week. When I do order, it's usually a burger-based meal, most often something familiar like an in-and-out double-double or a five guys cheeseburger, usually a burger, fries, sometimes a shake. I don't deviate very much when I'm short on time. I think what triggers those orders is usually time pressure and location, long days, running errands, driving between commitments or getting home later than I planned.
Agent: Thank you for sharing that. Now, what does "good value" mean to you in fast food? Could you pick your top two or three factors, such as taste, portion size, speed, nutrition, consistency, or price, and explain how you judge if something is "worth it"?
